phonon-tts 0.6.0 (MIT OR Apache-2.0), https://github.com/gradium-ai/xn-ptts, from npm. Unmodified, except that wasm-threads/ (the multi-thread build, which needs a cross-origin isolated page the app does not have) and the type declarations are left out. Model weights are not bundled: phonon-31m-en (Apache-2.0) downloads from Hugging Face.
